title: Onboard MistralX-30B v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Priya Kapoor
description: Onboard MistralX-30B v1.0 into the model registry with canonical metadata, performance profiles for common Redwood instance types, and automated changelog/release-notes generation. Motivation: MistralX-30B is a high-throughput open model some customers have requested; we need consistent perf profiles, accurate metadata for routing decisions, and a changelog entry produced automatically when the model is published. This PR includes: 1) model metadata JSON (architecture, tokenizer, revision, recommended quantization profiles, model_size, context_window), 2) perf profiles (latency p50/p95, tokens/sec throughput on A100/H100 and t4g test harness results), 3) a small integration test to validate registry entries, 4) automation to append a generated changelog entry into changelogs/models/ and wire the entry into our release_notes pipeline. Checklist: - [x] Add canonical metadata and model card URL - [x] Add perf profiles and underlying bench artifacts - [x] Add quantization recommendations (8-bit/4-bit where validated) - [x] Add unit/integration tests - [x] Add changelog generation script and CI step - [x] Update registry index and model catalog mapping Notes: Perf bench was run on both internal perf-canary infra and on CI-perf job; an initial flaky result on the throughput test was mitigated by increasing warmup iterations. The description and all sections are kept in a single continuous body to match repository PR norms.
